target.title: fix(chutes): widen OAuth redirect loopback check to full 127.0.0.0/8 range
target.body:
## What

Changed `parseRedirectUri` hostname validation from exact `"127.0.0.1"` match to `hostname.startsWith("127.")`, covering the full 127.0.0.0/8 loopback range.

## Why

The Chutes OAuth redirect URI validation only accepted exact `127.0.0.1`, rejecting other valid loopback addresses like `127.0.0.2`. The error message also suggested only `127.0.0.1` is valid, which is incorrect — the entire 127/8 block is loopback per the canonical implementation in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts`.

## Evidence

- Affected file: `extensions/chutes/oauth.ts`, `parseRedirectUri` function
- No other callers depend on the exact-match behavior
- The canonical `isLoopbackIpAddress` in `packages/net-policy/src/ip.ts` uses `ipaddr.js` range check covering full 127/8
